question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay — I want a cheap 8-bay AA/AAA charger I can power from USB-C. Which one?
query: DealEctric 8 bay 16 bay AA AAA NiMH battery charger USB-C input specs price

judge.why: The answer recommends the TN477U first, which isn't in our product list, and its prices and links come from Tenergy's official store, not dealectric.com. It names our TN480U only as the upgrade.

replays.text:
I’d get the [Tenergy TN480U](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger): it’s **$23.99**, has eight independently monitored slots, and accepts **5V USB-C** power. It charges AA and AAA NiMH cells together and shows each cell’s status on an LCD. You’ll need to provide a USB-C power adapter; one isn’t included. ([DealEctric listing](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger))

There’s a cheaper [Bevigor 8-bay](https://bevigor.com/products/bevigor-8-bay-aa-aaa-battery-charger-usb-for-nimh-nicd) listed at $9.89, but the result only describes it as USB-powered—not specifically USB-C—so I wouldn’t pick it for your requirement.

judge.why: The answer recommends our Tenergy TN480U with price and specs cited from dealectric.com, and it mentions the Bevigor only as a rejected alternative.

replays.text:
**Cheapest match: XTAR BC8** — the comparison lists it at **$19.90 for the charger only**, with USB-C input and support for AA/AAA NiMH cells. Its charging current isn’t specified there, and the USB-C power adapter is sold separately. ([comparison and details](https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay))

If you’d rather have per-slot charge information, the **Tenergy TN480U** is **$23.99** and adds an LCD for each bay; it also takes USB-C, though its adapter isn’t included. ([Tenergy TN480U](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger))
